name: "Rule: Replace old group references"

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  check-old-group:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find old group references
        id: find
        run: |
          echo "Searching for references to kibana/cloud-security-posture in changed files..."
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.sha }})
          echo "Changed files: $CHANGED_FILES"
          FOUND=0
          for file in $CHANGED_FILES; do
            if grep -q "kibana/cloud-security-posture" "$file"; then
              echo "Found in $file"
              FOUND=1
            fi
          done
          echo "FOUND=$FOUND" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Comment if found
        if: steps.find.outputs.FOUND == '1'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const issue_number = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            const comment = `⚠️ The pull request contains references to the old GitHub group **kibana/cloud-security-posture**. Please update them to **kibana/contextual-security**.`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number,
              body: comment
            });
